name: Residual-slack refinement below certified AON constructions
target: certified construction upper K+1 minus exact K+1
training: four-input discovery split plus five-input exact costs 0 through 11
model_selection: largest 100%-calibrated mean reduction on the seeded four-input selection split
student: depth-5 regression tree fit to the selected teacher predictions
cost12_calibration: maximum nonnegative predicted-slack overestimate across both existing cost-12 cohorts
cost13_evaluation: 80 largest predicted calibrated reductions in a seeded 1000-function pool plus 40 random functions from the remainder
notes: Cost 12 chooses only the safety correction, not the model family. Cost 13 must not be inspected until the frozen model and protocol artifact hashes exist.
